sources.caveat: Licence inspected 2026-09-08: re-use subject to the Irish PSI licence (Directive 2003/98/EC; circular per/2016/12); station-details dataset on data.gov.ie is CC BY 4.0. Station ref 12002 is within the 00001-41000 range OPW marks as suitable for republication. Real-time waterlevel.ie values are provisional/raw/unchecked with a 5-week rolling window only; processed/archival series and Annual Maxima are via Hydro-Data (waterlevel.ie/hydro-data, opw.ie/hydro). Whether the 12002 record extends back to November 2000 is NOT yet confirmed. Latest illustrative reading captured 8 Sep 2026 21:45 UTC: staff gauge 0.365 m / 0.421 m OD (provisional).
